svg.title: Horsepasture total phosphorus: results and original reporting limits
svg.desc: Original total-phosphorus records, USEPA 365.1, reported as P. Filled circles are uncensored results; open circles retain coded qualifications. Open triangles locate each original practical quantitation limit for a non-detected result; their vertical position is the reporting limit, not an estimated concentration. Original media-subdivision labels change from blank to Surface Water in 2013 and remain separate in comparison-groups.csv. All 144 records, methods, comments and 88 non-detections remain traceable to original result and limit files.
